morgan: Quick q: when someone visits an old bookmark that points to a moved console item, do we prefer to show the canonical breadcrumb and keep the old URL, or replace the URL with the new path?

tara: Keep URLs stable for external links. Show canonical breadcrumb and a small "moved" chip. One-shot toast on first visit.

devin: Implementation: router checks alias map -> resolves to canonical node -> render canonical breadcrumb. We can choose to history.replaceState(canonical) if product wants canonical URLs for sharing.

alex: UX note: if we replace the URL automatically, that's surprising for users who copy the link. I lean toward leaving the browser URL and showing the canonical path in the UI.

sam: A11y: ensure when auto-expanding groups we move focus to the item and announce via aria-live: "Opened X, now under Assets > Models". The moved chip must be keyboard focusable if it opens a tooltip.

lina: Metrics: instrument alias hits and % of deep-linked sessions using legacy paths. Track 404 spikes for two weeks post-rollout.

devin: alias example: `{"/old/workspaces/:wid/models/:mid": "/assets/models/:mid"}`. We'll keep this mapping versioned in infra.

morgan: plan: dev owns alias mapping + focus/scroll, design provides chip/toast visuals and copy, a11y provides acceptance. I'll open the PR and tag folks.
